extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: four-storey mixed-use city block module, exactly 10.0 m wide (party walls on both sides), approx. 14.6 m deep incl. balconies, awning and bike stands, 15.6 m tall to the chimney (14.2 m to the parapet)
extras.notes: exterior only (closed building, opaque windows, no interior); front faces -Y; modular: flat party walls on -X/+X with nothing protruding, so copies placed every 10.0 m along X form a seamless street front; shopping-bag pictogram instead of a shop sign, no lettering, no brand; no movable parts

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
